personal_info.summary: Frontend Developer with +4 years of experience working on Web (React, Vue) and Mobile (React Native). Always taking an active approach to problem-solving and learning quickly when needed.

responsibilities: Driving innovation in the Fenix rebuild initiative by contributing UX/UI ideas and technical solutions that directly influence the project's architecture.
Enhanced platform stability by diagnosing and resolving several critical bugs across the frontend, improving overall system uptime and user satisfaction.
Built highly performant, responsive headless CMS sites based on client needs using from Next.js with Sanity to WordPress headless.
Debugged and fixed errors in unmaintained client projects and introduced plans to improve those existing projects.
Improved company insight by at least 20% by developing an analytics dashboard with multiple business data.
Reduced errors and problems reported by customers by over 70% by remaking the campaigns section.
Increased the number of customers using the automate section by implementing a new self-managed chatbot on the site, which led to more revenue coming from that area.
Reduced support tickets by 40%. Using React, built a profile section for the users, where they can view their personal data and KYC level.
Helped increase account balance usage by more than 30% by making a 'Services' section, where the user can transfer money from their account balance to other financial institutions.
Increased site conversions by 10% by improving the company landing page layout and SEO rank of the company site to drive more people to the site.
Improved client conversions by over 70% by creating several landing pages tailored to different client needs.
Provided help in multiple React Native projects that facilitated easier future maintenance.
